population_rule: filing_timestamp_a5.sensitive_accessions: H4-sample filings whose <=5h time error could cross the H6a development-window or year edge, flip a 365-day restatement indicator, or reorder same-company 10-Ks.
policy: A4 rules unchanged: 60s uncounted retry on the first 502/504 per URL; counted 600s pauses (cap 12) for repeats and 503/429; 3% gateway-rate stop; 2h wall.
report_rule: A3/A4 qualification rule with the A4 clock basis; the basis must not fail a CB1 replication on these older headers when estimable (S1 n>=30), and is reported as non-estimable otherwise. Effects compare stored and qualified times on H6a development indicators, year, window and H4 10-K order.
